text: The source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest is the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography dataset, version 2021. This dataset identified 13.1 hectares of the loss area as native forest, with no planted forest detected. The classification is corroborated by the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset, which mapped 98% of the event area as forest in 2020.
